title: Can a local git remote replace GitHub in your agent eval?
summary:
We swapped GitHub for a local git remote in our agent evals. Rebasing and pushing on request were unaffected, but the agent pushed on its own 11 points less often. Here's when a local remote is a safe shortcut, and when it isn't.

The post Can a local git remote replace GitHub in your agent eval? appeared first on Microsoft for Developers.

title: Introducing the Agent Experience (AX) Practitioner Playbook
summary:
AI coding agents now pick the SDK, the version, and the pattern for your developers. The AX Practitioner Playbook is our method for finding out whether they get your technology right, and for fixing the sources they rely on when they don't.

The post Introducing the Agent Experience (AX) Practitioner Playbook appeared first on Microsoft for Developers.
